_readme: This file decides which lab section(s) each synced publication appears under.
ORCID/Google Scholar have no idea what 'Altmetrics' or 'Retractions' means as a topic -
that mapping only exists in your head, so it has to be entered here by hand.
1. Run the sync (Actions tab -> Sync Publications -> Run workflow).
2. Open data/publications.json and find the paper you want to tag - copy its "key" value.
4. A paper can belong to more than one lab - just list multiple lab ids.
5. Commit the change. The website reads this file directly, no rebuild needed.
Valid lab ids (must match the id= on each lab section in index.html):
altmetrics, context, inequality, trends, content, conventional,
